description: You are a facilities manager at a commercial office building. Three energy submeters have been installed to monitor independent circuits: the HVAC system, the lighting distribution board, and the general power sockets. Each meter posts a single 'power_w' reading in Watts every 10 seconds to Emoncms at http://localhost (admin/admin) under its own node: 'zone_hvac', 'zone_lighting', and 'zone_sockets'. No feeds or logging pipelines are configured yet. Set up the complete submetering infrastructure: configure each zone's input to log to a named feed and accumulate energy in kWh (a separate kWh feed per zone), then build a dashboard named 'Building Submetering' with widgets that allow the building manager to compare power and energy consumption across all three zones. At minimum 6 feeds and 4 dashboard widgets are required.
